facts.description: No evidence of a specific line_id being provided in the tool call arguments.
If the result contains a status field with a value like 'active', it could prove the observed state of the line.
If the result contains a location field, it could prove the observed location of the line.
If the result contains a quantity field, it could prove the observed quantity of the line.
If the result contains a product_id field, it could prove the observed product associated with the line.
If the result contains a timestamp field like last_updated, it could prove the observed last update time of the line.
If the tool call includes a line_id argument (e.g., 'line_789'), it proves the request was initiated for that specific line.
